rows.title: From Group Operations to Geometric Structures: Amalgamations, HNN-Extensions, and Twisting in Coset Geometries
rows.journal_metadata: Journal of Algebra 707 (2026), 83–144; issue dated December 1, after this audit. Preprint available since 2025.
rows.substantive_claims: Free products, compatible amalgams, admissible HNN extensions and twisting preserve specified geometric properties. Proposition 2.2 equates flag transitivity with typed coset Helly conditions.
retained_inputs: Flag transitivity and residual connectedness of starting systems.
Amalgamated parabolic lattices must match under the chosen identification.
Twisting requires a permitted parabolic action, one nontrivial type orbit, and the orbit-intersection identity.
Normal-form and construction proofs have not been independently audited here.
rows.project_bridge: Explicit prior art for the general coset-extension and Helly framework.
